description: Updates a user's License Assignment. (Not supported by cloud-based Polarion X.). Cardinality: targets a single item by ID. For the full collection or a batch, use `patchLicenseAssignments` instead. Effect: idempotent — calling it again with the same input leaves the resource in the same end state, with no additional side effects. Tip: set `dry_run: true` first to validate the arguments and preview the exact request without sending it to Polarion. The executor returns this preview as normal text, and as structured content when the tool declares an output schema.

dry_run.description: If true, validates the request and returns the exact request that would be sent to Polarion — with the Authorization header redacted and any binary payload summarized by byte length — without actually sending it.

name: patchLicenseAssignment
